title: Glowing red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Apple body base - deep red -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="32" ry="30" fill="#cc2233"/>
  <!-- Apple highlight/glow - lighter red/orange -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="28" ry="26" fill="#ff4455"/>
  <!-- Inner glow - warm orange -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="60" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#ff6655"/>
  <!-- Bright center highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="54" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#ff9977"/>
  <!-- Top dimple shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="12" ry="5" fill="#aa1a28"/>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="48" y="22" width="4" height="14" rx="2" fill="#885522"/>
  <!-- Stem highlight -->
  <rect x="49" y="23" width="2" height="12" rx="1" fill="#bb7733"/>
  <!-- Leaf base -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="26" rx="12" ry="6" transform="rotate(-30 60 26)" fill="#33aa44"/>
  <!-- Leaf highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="25" rx="8" ry="3.5" transform="rotate(-30 60 25)" fill="#66dd66"/>
  <!-- Leaf vein -->
  <line x1="52" y1="29" x2="68" y2="23" stroke="#228833" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Bottom shadow curve to give roundness -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="20" ry="8" fill="#aa1a28" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Small shine dot -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="3" fill="#ffddcc" opacity="0.9"/>
</svg>
